angle_definition: Ndir encodes absolute nacelle heading; yaw encodes observed Wdir, already relative to nacelle. Eight channels and per-slot initial scales are retained. Legacy joint-angle missingness is preserved.
decision: Compare fixed epoch8 against the frozen v5 reference on identical internal windows and labels. Report both MAE and RMSE; do not reselect an earlier epoch. No automatic outer refit or seed expansion.
scope_note: Only the operating-angle coordinate convention changes. Both matched pretraining and finetuning use the corrected frame. Existing numerical normalization, data labels, missingness, losses, LR, seed and Wiki results are preserved. Internal holdout is previously inspected development evidence; outer validation and sealed test are not evaluated.
